title: 13.20. Ajjhattattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Ajjhattaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nabahiddhā dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā.
Bahiddhā dhammaṁ paṭicca naajjhatto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
